fikir: Gerçekçi, sinematik bir tarih filmi sahnesi; 60 saniye. Fethin üçüncü günü, Haziran 1453, öğleden sonra. Bütün sahne İstanbul kara surlarındaki Topkapı'nın şehir içi tarafından, kapının kemerinden dışarıya, batıya bakan kameralarla çekiliyor (Fausto Zonaro'nun tablosundaki bakış). Güneş batıda, kapının arkasında: dışarıdaki toprak yol altın ışık içinde, yolun iki yanında sıra sıra saf tutmuş kırmızı kaftanlı, beyaz börklü yeniçeriler ve yalnızca tek beyaz hilalli, yıldızsız, yazısız kırmızı sancaklar; içerideki meydan surun uzun gölgesinde. Meydanda korku içinde diz çökmüş, başları önde yüzlerce Rum: kadınlar, erkekler, yaşlılar; aralarında altı yaşındaki oğlunu bağrına basmış genç bir anne. Uzaktan yaklaşan mehter marşı ve ordunun uğultusu. Genç Sultan II. Mehmed (21 yaşında, ince bıyıklı, kısa sakallı, gümüş zırh, kırmızı kaftan, sorguçlu miğfer) beyaz atıyla yolun sonundan kapıya ilerliyor; yanında yaya hocası Akşemseddin. Tören alayıyla geliyor: önde ağır bir marş çalan mehter takımı, atlı çavuşlar, sancaktarlar ve yaldızlı alem; Sultan'ın iki yanında yaya, kırmızı kaftanlı, beyaz sorguçlu solaklar; arkasında atlı vezirler ve paşalar, yeniçeri ağası ve sıra sıra yeniçeriler. Mehter kemerin önünde susuyor; Sultan kemerin altına girip ters ışık içinde duruyor, uğultu kesiliyor. Akşemseddin: "Hünkârım, Peygamber efendimizin müjdesi bugün gerçek oldu." Sultan: "Bu zafer bizim değil, Allah'ındır." Sultan kemerden meydanın gölgesine çıkıyor; diz çökmüş kalabalığı görüyor; anne oğlunu daha sıkı tutuyor. Sultan'ın yüzü yumuşuyor. Sultan yüksek, sakin ve güven veren bir sesle: "Kalkınız ve müsterih olunuz. Ben Sultan Mehmed; hepinize söylüyorum ki bu andan itibaren ne hürriyetleriniz ne de hayatlarınız hakkında korkmayınız." Halk başını kaldırıyor, anne ve çocuk dahil yavaşça ayağa kalkıyor, rahatlamış bir mırıltı yayılıyor. Kan, ceset, yaralı ya da yağma yok; ağırbaşlı ve törensel.

bloklar.ozet: From inside the shadowed square, past the bowed heads of the kneeling crowd, the full ceremonial procession comes up the sunlit road toward the gate between the janissary ranks: the mehter band playing a slow march, mounted heralds and standard-bearers with banners and a gilded alem, then the Sultan on his white horse flanked by solak guards, Akşemseddin at his right stirrup, the viziers and pashas on horseback behind. The band and banners halt and part before the gate; the Sultan rides into the arch and halts in its golden backlight; the music stops and the murmur fades into silence.

Under the arch, in backlight, solak guards on both sides, the mounted pashas and banners behind. Akşemseddin looks up at the Sultan and speaks; the Sultan breathes in and answers calmly; he then looks ahead into the shadowed square.

bloklar.ozet: The Sultan rides a few steps out of the arch into the shadow of the square and stops; the solak guards fan out in two lines beside him, the pashas and standard-bearers fill the arch behind. Over his shoulder: hundreds of Greek townspeople kneel with bowed heads. Close on the young mother pressing her son to her chest, trembling, her eyes lifting for a moment. The Sultan's face softens.

The Sultan addresses the kneeling crowd in a loud, calm, reassuring voice. As he finishes, the people lift their heads in astonishment and slowly rise, the mother and child too; a relieved murmur spreads. No violence, no disorder.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photoreal, cinematic historical film shot on 35mm film with natural light. Late afternoon, June 1453. The sun is low in the west, directly behind the gate: the road outside glows golden, the inner square lies in cool blue-grey shadow, and a strong golden backlight pours through the arch, rim-lighting anyone who stands in it; fine dust hangs in the shafts of light. Colour palette: crimson red, warm limestone cream, terracotta brick, cool shadow blue-grey, burnished silver, golden backlight. Faces, armour, robes, the horse and the place stay exactly the same as in the reference pictures. The Sultan's ceremonial procession (alay): at its head a mehter band on foot, kettle drums, big drums, zurnas and cymbals, in red and green kaftans with tall caps, playing a slow, heavy march; behind them mounted çavuş heralds and standard-bearers carrying tall plain crimson banners with a single white crescent and a gilded alem finial; then the Sultan on his white horse, flanked on foot by two rows of solak guards in identical red kaftans and tall white plumed börk caps with bows across their backs, Akşemseddin walking at his right stirrup; behind him the viziers and pashas on horseback, grey-bearded men in long dark-green and deep-blue kaftans with large white turbans, the janissary ağa, and long rows of janissaries on foot. Each group wears identical uniforms. No readable text, signboards, logos or lettering anywhere in the frame, including on walls, houses and the road through the arch; the banners carry only a single plain white crescent, with no star and no writing.
[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, a locked-off medium close-up of <Subject 1>, 50mm lens, exactly the framing of the end of the previous block: the Sultan on his white horse, rim-lit from behind, the white turban of <Subject 2> at the lower edge of the frame. For the first 1.5 seconds he holds still. At about 1.5 seconds, with a loud, calm and reassuring measured young baritone voice (S1), he says to the crowd: <d>[Turkish] Kalkınız ve müsterih olunuz. Ben Sultan Mehmed; hepinize söylüyorum ki bu andan itibaren ne hürriyetleriniz ne de hayatlarınız hakkında korkmayınız.</d> His lips move clearly and only while he speaks.
[Shot 2] At 00:10.500, a locked-off wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind <Subject 1>, 28mm lens. Across the shaded square, between the still lines of solak guards, the townspeople lift their heads in astonishment and slowly rise to their feet; <Subject 3> rises holding her son close. Everyone stands still, faces turned to the Sultan, for the final 0.5 seconds.

brief:
Follow this story bible exactly. Keep the block count and each block's duration as given.
Continuity across blocks: every block after the first OPENS with the same framing, camera position, character positions and light as the last shot of the previous block, continuing from its calm final moment, so the join plays like one continuous take; change shot size only after the block's first shot.
Characters: Sultan II. Mehmed (speaker S1, voice: measured, resonant young baritone, calm and commanding, clear formal Istanbul Turkish); Akşemseddin (speaker S2, voice: warm, deep, slightly weathered baritone, slow and reverent, Istanbul Turkish); Rum anne ve oğlu
Place: Topkapı, şehir içinden — The city-side (inner) face of Topkapı on the Theodosian land walls, seen from inside the city looking west through the open gate: pale cream limestone blocks with horizontal red-brick bands, crenellated battlements, fresh siege breaches and soot-blackened stone, a tall brick-arched gate passage with both heavy wooden gate leaves thrown fully open against the walls. Through the arch the sunlit packed-earth road outside runs straight away into the distance; fixed ranks of janissaries in crimson kaftans and tall white felt börk caps line both sides of that outside road for the whole video, holding plain crimson banners that each bear only a single white crescent, no star and no writing. On the inner side, a wide dusty square of packed earth and worn paving stones lies in the long shadow of the wall, edged by weathered two-storey stone houses with timber balconies and tiled roofs; the square and the gate passage are empty.
Block 1 — exactly 15 seconds: From inside the shadowed square, past the bowed heads of the kneeling crowd, the full ceremonial procession comes up the sunlit road toward the gate between the janissary ranks: the mehter band playing a slow march, mounted heralds and standard-bearers with banners and a gilded alem, then the Sultan on his white horse flanked by solak guards, Akşemseddin at his right stirrup, the viziers and pashas on horseback behind. The band and banners halt and part before the gate; the Sultan rides into the arch and halts in its golden backlight; the music stops and the murmur fades into silence.
Block 2 — exactly 15 seconds: Under the arch, in backlight, solak guards on both sides, the mounted pashas and banners behind. Akşemseddin looks up at the Sultan and speaks; the Sultan breathes in and answers calmly; he then looks ahead into the shadowed square. Akşemseddin (S2) says in Turkish: "Hünkârım, Peygamber efendimizin müjdesi bugün gerçek oldu." Sultan II. Mehmed (S1) says in Turkish: "Bu zafer bizim değil, Allah'ındır."
Block 3 — exactly 15 seconds: The Sultan rides a few steps out of the arch into the shadow of the square and stops; the solak guards fan out in two lines beside him, the pashas and standard-bearers fill the arch behind. Over his shoulder: hundreds of Greek townspeople kneel with bowed heads. Close on the young mother pressing her son to her chest, trembling, her eyes lifting for a moment. The Sultan's face softens.
Block 4 — exactly 15 seconds: The Sultan addresses the kneeling crowd in a loud, calm, reassuring voice. As he finishes, the people lift their heads in astonishment and slowly rise, the mother and child too; a relieved murmur spreads. No violence, no disorder. Sultan II. Mehmed (S1) says in Turkish: "Kalkınız ve müsterih olunuz. Ben Sultan Mehmed; hepinize söylüyorum ki bu andan itibaren ne hürriyetleriniz ne de hayatlarınız hakkında korkmayınız."
